title: Mara and the Signal
author: Isandro Iversen
blurb: Odile Underhill, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
